related.title: CycloneDX VEX：適用性聲明與證據到期
related.titleEn: CycloneDX VEX: applicability claims and evidence expiry
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付30項聯集差異表、服務變更、元件歸因與盤點範圍說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a thirty-entry union diff, service changes, component attribution and inventory-scope statement.
related.difference: 為每個不受影響聲明附產品版本、理由、證據與重驗條件；未知不可默認成不受影響。
related.differenceEn: Attach product version, justification, evidence and revalidation conditions to each not-affected claim; unknown never defaults to not affected.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Jaccard相似度=交集/聯集；它衡量盤點重疊，不代表安全程度或BOM完整性。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 版本A有24個元件，B有26個，共20個身分版本配對相同。 聯集24+26−20=30；相似度20/30=66.6667%。
待處理=受影響+調查中+過期聲明；完成狀態與證據新鮮度是不同維度。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 20份合成聲明：8份有證據而不受影響、5份受影響、4份已修復、3份調查中。 初始待處理5+3=8份，占40%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Jaccard similarity equals intersection over union; it measures inventory overlap, not security or BOM completeness. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Version A has twenty-four components and B twenty-six; twenty identity-version pairs are shared. The union is 24+26−20=30, giving similarity 20/30=66.6667%.

Actionable items include affected, under-investigation and expired claims; disposition and freshness are separate dimensions. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Twenty synthetic claims comprise eight evidenced not-affected, five affected, four fixed and three under investigation. Initially 5+3=8 claims require action, or 40%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Docker Rootless：容器身分與主機權限邊界
related.titleEn: Docker Rootless: container identities and host privilege boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付30項聯集差異表、服務變更、元件歸因與盤點範圍說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a thirty-entry union diff, service changes, component attribution and inventory-scope statement.
related.difference: 分清容器內UID、主機UID映射、capability與掛載可寫性，列出仍存在的信任邊界。
related.differenceEn: Separate container UID, host UID mapping, capabilities and writable mounts, listing remaining trust boundaries.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Jaccard相似度=交集/聯集；它衡量盤點重疊，不代表安全程度或BOM完整性。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 版本A有24個元件，B有26個，共20個身分版本配對相同。 聯集24+26−20=30；相似度20/30=66.6667%。
本課權限面積以允許能力數×可寫掛載數作粗略代理；不是可量測的入侵機率。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 配置A允許12項能力及4個可寫掛載；配置B只需3項能力及2個可寫掛載。 代理量A=48、B=6，縮減(48−6)/48=87.5%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Jaccard similarity equals intersection over union; it measures inventory overlap, not security or BOM completeness. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Version A has twenty-four components and B twenty-six; twenty identity-version pairs are shared. The union is 24+26−20=30, giving similarity 20/30=66.6667%.

A teaching privilege-surface proxy multiplies allowed capabilities by writable mounts; it is not an intrusion probability. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Configuration A allows twelve capabilities and four writable mounts; B needs three capabilities and two writable mounts. The proxy falls from 48 to 6, a reduction of 87.5%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
